scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run db:seed --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.demo: concurrently -k -n nodes,web -c blue,magenta "npm run demo --prefix backend" "cross-env VITE_USE_MOCKS=false npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.demo2: cross-env VITE_USE_MOCKS=false VITE_API_TARGET=http://localhost:3002 npm run dev --prefix frontend -- --port 5174
scripts.check: npm run check --prefix backend && npm run check --prefix frontend
